Our Hiring Process

Fast, transparent, and respectful of your time. No 8-round marathons.

Intro Call

A 30-minute chat with the founders to discuss your background, our vision, and ensure alignment on culture and expectations.

1
Technical Deep Dive

A 60-minute technical interview focusing on system architecture, your past complex projects, and Python/React proficiency. No Leetcode trick questions.

2
Meet the Team & Offer

Come to our Tel Aviv office, meet the rest of the R&D team, grab a coffee (or beer), and if it's a match, we make an offer.
